standards.acceptance: Launched desktop path boots, chats, perceives, acts, retries, and shuts down without fallback loops, duplicate kernels, RAM runaway, or false health.
standards.label: Daily Runtime Reliability

standards.acceptance: Conversation remains contextual, self-consistent, non-canned, and full-mind routed over multi-turn desktop use.
standards.label: Conversational Human-Likeness

standards.acceptance: Capabilities from fictional assistants map to governed real mechanisms: local/web actuation, memory, perception, speech, self-modeling, safety, planning, and sustained autonomy.
standards.label: Sci-Fi AI Capability Envelope

standards.acceptance: Do not claim subjectivity; prove functional correlates that are causal, ablatable, introspectable, and falsifiable against zombie/baseline controls.
standards.label: Phenomenal-State Building Blocks

standards.acceptance: Native reasoning organs, exact solvers, verifier-derived preference data, and local reasoning-model lanes improve outputs without external servers.
standards.label: Frontier Reasoning Outside The Model

standards.acceptance: Show bounded recursive improvement ingredients: discovery, self-critique, safe mutation, validation, preference harvest, and local model upgrade path.
standards.label: Superintelligence Trajectory

standards.acceptance: Computer use is perception-driven, governed, visible when requested, effect-verified, and recoverable from focus/popup/context failures.
standards.label: Frontier OS Control

standards.acceptance: Use a general environment kernel with perception, memory horizon, reflexes, planning, and post-mortem learning rather than NetHack-only shortcuts.
standards.label: NetHack-Class General Environment Competence

standards.acceptance: Demonstrate cross-domain planning, tool use, memory, learning, self-repair, reasoning, and transfer under hidden or sealed tests.
standards.label: Generally Capable AI
